<?php
/**
 * PDF Generation Service with Circuit Breaker Pattern
 * Handles high-volume PDF rendering with fault tolerance
 */

namespace App\Services\Pdf;

use App\Core\CircuitBreaker;
use App\Core\TokenManager;

class PdfGeneratorService
{
    private CircuitBreaker $circuitBreaker;
    private TokenManager $tokenManager;
    private string $templateDir;
    private array $config;

    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->templateDir = realpath($config['template_dir']);
        $this->circuitBreaker = new CircuitBreaker(
            failureThreshold: $config['cb_failure_threshold'] ?? 5,
            recoveryTimeout: $config['cb_recovery_timeout'] ?? 30,
            halfOpenMax: $config['cb_half_open_max'] ?? 3
        );
        $this->tokenManager = new TokenManager($config['secret_key']);
    }

    /**
     * Main endpoint handler for PDF generation requests
     */
    public function handleRequest(): void
    {
        session_start();
        $method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];

        if ($method === 'GET') {
            $this->renderForm();
            return;
        }

        if ($method === 'POST') {
            $this->processGeneration();
            return;
        }

        http_response_code(405);
    }

    private function renderForm(): void
    {
        $token = $this->tokenManager->generateToken($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? '');
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = $token;
        
        header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');
        echo '<form method="POST" action="/pdf/generate">';
        echo '<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="' . htmlspecialchars($token) . '">';
        echo '<input type="text" name="title" placeholder="Document Title">';
        echo '<textarea name="content">Enter content</textarea>';
        echo '<select name="template"><option value="invoice">Invoice</option>';
        echo '<option value="report">Report</option></select>';
        echo '<button type="submit">Generate PDF</button></form>';
    }

    private function processGeneration(): void
    {
        $submittedToken = $_POST['csrf_token'] ?? '';
        $sessionToken = $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '';

        if (!$this->validateCsrfToken($submittedToken, $sessionToken)) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request token']);
            return;
        }

        // Invalidate token after use to prevent replay
        unset($_SESSION['csrf_token']);

        $title = htmlspecialchars($_POST['title'] ?? 'Untitled', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $content = htmlspecialchars($_POST['content'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $template = $_POST['template'] ?? 'invoice';

        $result = $this->circuitBreaker->execute(function () use ($title, $content, $template) {
            return $this->generatePdf($title, $content, $template);
        });

        if ($result === false) {
            http_response_code(503);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Service temporarily unavailable']);
            return;
        }

        header('Content-Type: application/pdf');
        header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="document.pdf"');
        echo $result;
    }

    /**
     * CSRF token validation using timing-safe comparison
     * Validates token structure and matches against session
     */
    private function validateCsrfToken(string $submitted, string $stored): bool
    {
        if (empty($submitted) || empty($stored)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Decode the token to verify its internal structure
        $decoded = $this->tokenManager->decodeToken($submitted);
        if ($decoded === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Verify token hasn't expired (1 hour validity)
        if (time() - ($decoded['timestamp'] ?? 0) > 3600) {
            return false;
        }

        // Compare submitted token against stored session token
        return hash_equals($stored, $submitted);
    }

    private function generatePdf(string $title, string $content, string $template): string
    {
        $allowedTemplates = ['invoice', 'report', 'default'];
        if (!in_array($template, $allowedTemplates, true)) {
            $template = 'default';
        }

        $templatePath = $this->templateDir . '/' . $template . '.tpl';
        if (!file_exists($templatePath)) {
            $templatePath = $this->templateDir . '/default.tpl';
        }

        $html = file_get_contents($templatePath);
        $html = str_replace(['{{title}}', '{{content}}'], [$title, $content], $html);

        // Simulate PDF rendering via external service
        return $this->renderHtmlToPdf($html);
    }

    private function renderHtmlToPdf(string $html): string
    {
        // Simulated wkhtmltopdf call
        $tmpFile = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'pdf_');
        file_put_contents($tmpFile . '.html', $html);

        // Harden wkhtmltopdf against SSRF / local file disclosure:
        // disable JavaScript, block local file access and external links/requests.
        $output = shell_exec(sprintf(
            'wkhtmltopdf --quiet --disable-javascript --disable-local-file-access '
            . '--disable-external-links --disable-internal-links %s %s 2>&1',
            escapeshellarg($tmpFile . '.html'),
            escapeshellarg($tmpFile . '.pdf')
        ));

        $pdf = false;
        if (file_exists($tmpFile . '.pdf')) {
            $pdf = file_get_contents($tmpFile . '.pdf');
        }

        if (file_exists($tmpFile . '.html')) {
            unlink($tmpFile . '.html');
        }
        if (file_exists($tmpFile . '.pdf')) {
            unlink($tmpFile . '.pdf');
        }
        if (file_exists($tmpFile)) {
            unlink($tmpFile);
        }

        if ($pdf === false || $pdf === '') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('PDF rendering failed');
        }

        return $pdf;
    }
}

/**
 * Circuit Breaker implementation
 */
namespace App\Core;

class CircuitBreaker
{
    private int $failureCount = 0;
    private int $failureThreshold;
    private int $recoveryTimeout;
    private int $halfOpenMax;
    private int $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private string $state = 'closed';

    public function __construct(int $failureThreshold, int $recoveryTimeout, int $halfOpenMax)
    {
        $this->failureThreshold = $failureThreshold;
        $this->recoveryTimeout = $recoveryTimeout;
        $this->halfOpenMax = $halfOpenMax;
    }

    public function execute(callable $operation)
    {
        if ($this->state === 'open') {
            if (time() - $this->lastFailureTime >= $this->recoveryTimeout) {
                $this->state = 'half-open';
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }

        try {
            $result = $operation();
            $this->onSuccess();
            return $result;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->onFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }

    private function onSuccess(): void
    {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'closed';
    }

    private function onFailure(): void
    {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->failureThreshold) {
            $this->state = 'open';
        }
    }
}

class TokenManager
{
    private string $secretKey;

    public function __construct(string $secretKey)
    {
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }

    public function generateToken(string $userId): string
    {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'nonce' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
        ]);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey);
        return base64_encode($payload) . '.' . $signature;
    }

    public function decodeToken(string $token): ?array
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }

        [$encodedPayload, $signature] = $parts;
        $payload = base64_decode($encodedPayload, true);
        if ($payload === false) {
            return null;
        }

        // Verify signature integrity
        $expectedSignature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSignature, $signature)) {
            return null;
        }

        return json_decode($payload, true);
    }

    /**
     * Validates that a token is structurally valid and properly signed.
     * Used for stateless validation when session comparison is not needed.
     */
    public function isValidToken(string $token): bool
    {
        return $this->decodeToken($token) !== null;
    }
}
